children: China rail freight operator's interim revenue rose 24% yr/yr
Net profit attributable to shareholders increased to RMB36 mln from RMB31 mln a year earlier
Company cites increased coal transport and construction activity as main drivers of performance
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for the current quarter or full year
COAL, COKE AND ORE FREIGHT – Rail-freight revenue rose 12.0% to RMB125.6 mln, mainly on higher coal, coke and ore-fines transportation
SPECIAL RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION – Ancillary-services revenue rose 91.5% to RMB37.5 mln, primarily from constructing a special railway line
MARKETING INITIATIVES - Co said proactive marketing and expansion efforts in upstream markets contributed to improved performance
